title: Ejecutar verificación Chromium CI de José V11
mission: Reuse the already-proven bounded GitHub Actions/Playwright browser-verification pattern to execute the exact José V11 reviewable candidate in representative Chromium with GitHub Pages and api.github.com network access. This is an execution path for the existing unrestricted-browser contract, not a new product direction or authority surface.

Require the immutable-source gate to reach VERIFICADO only after decoded bytes equal 69235 and SHA-256 equals 0cf9a40fb53e977dccb40c9755d668a3ee922ccd61883f19229bb4a113139a05.
Smoke-test the four topic-local map/practice surfaces after the verification gate passes in desktop and narrow representative viewports.

Persist workflow run/job/artifact identifiers, candidate/source identities, viewport results and exact failure evidence if any assertion cannot be completed.
Do not mutate V11, Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted or Served pointers and do not reinterpret static checks as browser PASS.
